# Shape iteration 0151

Iteration 0151 has one task: resume the unfinished attempt-ledger contract from `task/689` and finish it.

## What I found
- #689 (iteration 0150) ended `partial`, not merged, at branch `task/689`, commit `deceebc1`, after 35 turns and 17 attempts with cause `input_budget` and zero uploaded artifacts (`.session/history/records/0150.json`).
- Its report only repeats "All policy candidates are unavailable; durable checkpoint retained for resume" and does not say what was written (`.session/history/sessions/689/24e2c2bdf1d72fe48a5fcddf13373a955bc390aef050e9d7ded99266a3fbf403.md`).
- I have not seen the contents of `task/689`, so I make no claim about which contract files exist there.
- The failure was infrastructure (input budget, providers unavailable), with no evidence that the task was cut wrongly, so I resume it instead of rephrasing it.

## What I ordered
- `attempt-ledger-contract-0151`: role `benchmark`, model `default`, effort `high`, 90 minutes / 60 turns, `start_branch: task/689`, no dependencies.
- Scope and output names are unchanged from 0150: `benchmark/baseline/attempt-ledger-0150.md` and `.json`, design-only.
- It keeps the explicit export of report #685 and the same three #685 artifact inputs.
- The first acceptance item is now a three-call inventory of what the branch already holds; saved work that passes its criterion is kept, and #689 session artifacts are treated as lost unless present.
- If the contract files predate the expectations artifact, the worker must say the expectations are not prior to authorship.
- The read budget is narrower: Python key extraction and Grep line ranges instead of whole-file reads, both repository files written by about turn 25, and a `## What next` section if it cannot finish.
- Verification is one repository-only `python3 -I` check of file existence and JSON syntax; the substantive checks happen in-session because the engine cannot read session artifacts.

## Checks
- `.session/tasks.json` passed the direct Python JSON/heading validation (exit 0, "task JSON and headings: OK") after its only write.
- `journal/working-memory.md` is rewritten with the four sections.
- I ran no task, product, benchmark, evaluator or native code.

## Discoveries
- Glob with a directory in `path` and `*` in `pattern` returned the whole tree; the full pattern has to go in `pattern` (recorded in `journal/working-memory.md`, "Tried, do not repeat").

## What next
- If the resume task is done, the next shaper reads its report (inventory, reused versus new, hashes) and the new Markdown, then orders a separate changed-scope review by `reviewer`, pinned to the accepted commit, tree and hashes, with explicit report exports and the two artifact inputs.
- If it is partial again for the same cause, split it: one task for the two repository files and a second, `blocked_by` the first, for the expectations and application artifacts.
- `no_progress` is 2, so another iteration without an accepted improvement reaches the Policymaker trigger of 3.
- Do not repeat the #685 policy review, claim method readiness, or issue implementation from this supplement.
